content: Cawul ifekk tandint n Yabic di Jilɛad
Xenni iffeɣ-dd Naḥac, Aɛammuni, uca inneḍ s řɛeskar nnes i tendint n Yabic di Jilɛad. Marra iryazen n Yabic nnan i Naḥac: “Egg ijj n řɛahd akidneɣ uca xenni ad ac nsexxar.”
Inna asen Aɛammuni Naḥac: “X webrid-a necc akidwem ggeɣ řɛahd, necc ad awem dd-qeřɛeɣ marra tiṭṭ tafusect, ad tt ggeɣ d řefḍiḥet x marra Israil.”
Imɣaren n Yabic nnan: “Ejj aneɣ sebɛa n wussan, ḥima ad dd-nessekk ireqqasen ɣar marra tammurt n Israil. Mařa war nufi uřa d ijj i d aneɣ ɣa issnejmen, xenni ad ɣarek dd-neffeɣ.”
Umi dd-iwḍen ireqqasen ɣar Jibɛa n Cawul, ssiwḍen-dd nitni awařen-a ɣar imezzuɣen n řgens u marra řgens issgeɛɛed tmijja nnes, run.
U xzar, Cawul yusa-dd awarni i ifunasen nnes zeg iyyar, inna: “Min yuɣin řgens ittru ammu?” Nitni ḥajan as awařen n yeryazen n Yabic.
Ihwa-dd Arruḥ n AREBBI x Cawul umi isřa awařen-a uca yarɣa uxeyyeq nnes aṭṭas.

Netta iksi ijj n uzayřu n ifunasen, iqeṭṭes i-ten d iceǧiqen, issekk iceǧiqen s ufus n ireqqasen ɣar marra tammurt n Israil. Ireqqasen nnan: “Wenni war iffiɣen awarni i Cawul u awarni Camwil ɣar umenɣi, xzar, ammu i ɣa ittwagg ak-d ifunasen d tfunasin nnes.” Xenni tewḍa-dd tiggʷudi n SIDI x marra řgens uca ffɣen munen am yijj n weryaz.
Isedd i-ten Cawul di Bazaq. Tuɣa-ten di teřt-mya-ařef zeg ayt n Israil u třatin-ařef n yeryazen zi Yahuda.

Nitni nnan i ireqqasen nni tuɣa dd-yusin: “Ammu i ɣa tinim i yeryazen n Yabic di Jilɛad: ‘Tiwecca, xmi ɣa tiři tfuct tařɣa, ad tᵉttwassnejmem.’” Umi iwḍen ireqqasen, ɛawden tt i yeryazen n Yabic uca farḥen nitni.
Nnan yeryazen n Yabic: “Tiwecca ad ɣarek dd-neffeɣ uca xenni tzemmarem akidneɣ tᵉtteggem min tᵉttwařam kenniw mliḥ di tiṭṭawin nwem.”

Tiwecca nnes imsar, aqa Cawul ibḍa řgens x třata n ibaṭayunen u ɣar tuffut n ṣṣbeḥ udfen nitni ɣar řmargeḥ n řɛeskar, uca wtin ayt n Ɛammun ɣar ṭṭḥa n uziř. Inni iqqimen iddaren ttwabezzɛen ařami war iqqim uřa d tyuya zzaysen ak-d wayawya.
Xenni inna řgens i Camwil: “Man wen i innan: ‘Ma Cawul ad xaneɣ yiři d ajeǧid?’ Awyi ten-dd danita, ḥima ad ten neneɣ.”
Maca Cawul inna: “Deg wass-a uřa d ijjen war ittwaneɣ, maɣar ass-a SIDI issiweḍ-dd asenjem ɣar Israil.”
Inna Camwil i řgens: “Ejj aneɣ ad nuyur ɣar Jiljal, ad dinni nřeqqeḥ tagelda.”
Xenni yuyur marra řgens ɣar Jiljal u nitni ggin dinni di Jiljal Cawul d ajeǧid zzat i wudem n SIDI. Ɣarṣen tiɣarṣa n řehna zzat i wudem n SIDI uca ifarḥ Cawul aṭṭas ak-d marra iryazen n Israil.

footnotes.text: Aɛammuni- ijjen zi řgens n Ɛammun niɣ zi ayt n Ɛammun.
